repos_data.description: AppiumLibrary is an appium testing library for RobotFramework
A framework for speeding up the development of automated UI tests for Windows, Android, iOS, and Web with Appium/Selenium on .NET

Open-source test automation for Android, iOS, web, smart TV (Android TV, Tizen, webOS) and Bluetooth (BLE) devices. Write tests as CSV/YAML, record them live, or let an AI agent build them over MCP. Self-healing locators: XPath, text, OCR, image.

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI assistants to interact with web browsers and mobile applications using WebDriverIO. Automate Chrome browsers, iOS apps, and Android apps—all through a unified interface.
